{{Quote|Wesa free!|A [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] during the rally|<ref name="ROTJ" />}}
After the news of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] [[Death/Legends|death]] at the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] reached the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], the natives broke out in celebration, and some tried to '''force''' the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] off-world&mdash;albeit unsuccessfully.

==Background==
As part of his efforts to consolidate power and bring sovereign systems under [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] control, Palpatine sent a garrison force to Naboo, under the pretense that it would be protecting the planet's precious plasma energy resources.<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>

[[File:ISDNaboo.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Imperial forces fighting in and over a Naboo city]]
Despite being connected with the Emperor, the planet's rulers were never quite willing to cooperate fully with their Imperial supervisors, and quiet resistance against the local garrison brewed for many years.

The Gungans, who became marginalized during this period and mostly returned to their swamplands, also founded several [[Imperial vs. Gungan Battle|resistance]] cells. Despite this, the Gungans and human resistance fighters worked mostly in secret, fearing they were not strong enough to resist the legions stationed on the world.<ref name="SWG" />

==The uprising==
As it became known that Palpatine had died along with [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] aboard the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]], and that the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] had been victorious against their fleet, countless planets exploited the confusion and disarray amongst Imperial forces to liberate themselves from their oppressive rule. The citizens of Naboo took this opportunity, as well.<ref name="ROTJ" /><ref name="TEA-" />

Despite previous diplomatic behavior, the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] and the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] banded together to once more oust an oppressive force from their world. Naboo rebels mobilized their N-1 starfighters, while the Gungans contributed Militiagung soldiers to invade the [[Theed/Legends|capital]].<ref name="ROTJ" />

The [[Theed Royal Palace/Legends|Theed Royal Palace]] was stormed, and supporters of the Rebellion made their way through the palace, even up to the rooftops. This portion of the battle did not seem to have caused extensive damage to the exterior of the palace, based on its appearance immediately afterward. In the aftermath of the battle, the crowds were cheering on the plaza and atop the buildings, with at least one Gungan using the occasion to declare Naboo's freedom.<ref name="ROTJ" /> The celebrations didn't last long, as the local Imperial garrisons put down the insurrection.<ref name="TEA-" />

==Aftermath==
Despite the setback after Endor,<ref name="TEA-" /><ref name="Blog" /> the planet eventually became free of Imperial influence,<ref name="TEA-" /> and its sector was represented in the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]'' [[New Republic Senate/Legends|Senate]]'' by a [[Unidentified New Republic Gungan diplomat|Gungan Senator]].<ref name="TWLOSW:AFG">''[[The Wildlife of Star Wars: A Field Guide]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The battle, or rather, the aftermath, made its first appearance in the DVD version of [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']], in a redone sequence for the ending of the film, showing [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] celebrating Emperor Palpatine's death. Although the film implied that the Empire was successfully driven out,<ref name="Insider 82">{{InsiderCite|82|Ask Lobot|Ask the Master}}</ref> additional materials from ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' and ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' revealed that the Empire had suppressed the revolt.<ref name="TEA-" /><ref name="Blog" />
